notes.text: SIGNAL SPECIFIC NOTES - I
THIS PLAN IS BASED ON ENGINEERING SCALE PLAN (ESP) No:CAO/C/TR/YARDS/SC/KPHI/PH-I/04-2025/ALT.3 DT:24.06.2026.
THIS PLAN SUPERSEDES SIP No: NIL & CANCELS SIP NO. IPU 1582.
ALL THE STOP SIGNALS ARE LOCATED CLEAR OFF NEUTRAL SECTION AS PER IRSEM(2021).
ALL THE WORKS ARE CARRIED OUT AS PER THE PROVISIONS IN THE SEM, G&SR AND OTHER POLICY LETTERS.
THE CROSS OVER POINTS ARE OPERATED BY PARALLEL OPERATION.
REFER TABLE OF CONTROL FOR DETAILS OF ALL SIGNAL ROUTES.

EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE- PROCEDURE FOR EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE, WHEN TRAIN MOVEMENT NOT TAKEN PLACE i) CLICK ON SIGNAL CANCEL AND EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE. ii) THE ROUTE GETS RELEASED a) IMMEDIATELY WHEN APPROACH TRACK IS UP b) AFTER 120 SECONDS WHEN APPROACH TRACK IS DOWN/DEAD APPROACH. iii) EACH SUCH OPERATION, AS PER (b) ABOVE SHALL BE REGISTERED ON COUNTER.

SUPER EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE- PROCEDURE FOR SUPER EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE, WHEN TRAIN MOVEMENT TAKEN PLACE AND ROUTE NOT RELEASED i) INSERT PHYSICAL SUPER EMERGENCY KEY. ii) CLICK ON SIGNAL CANCEL AND SUPER EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE. iii) THE ROUTE GETS RELEASED AFTER 120 SECONDS. iv) EACH SUCH OPERATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON COUNTER.

EMERGENCY POINT OPERATION(EWN)- PROCEDURE FOR EMERGENCY POINT OPERATION DURING POINT TRACK CIRCUIT FAIL CONDITION i) WHEN POINT IS NOT LOCKED BY SIGNAL, THEN INSERT PHYSICAL EMERGENCY EWN KEY ii) CLICK ON CONCERNED POINT TO SELECT THE EMERGENCY POINT OPERATION (N/R) AS THE CASE MAY BE AND CLICK ON "CONFIRMATION (OK)". iii) EACH SUCH OPERATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON COUNTER.

EMERGENCY OVERLAP ROUTE RELEASE(OYN)- PROCEDURE FOR EMERGENCY OVERLAP RELEASE WHEN HOME SIGNAL ROUTE NOT RELEASED AFTER COMPLETE ARRIVAL OF TRAIN ON BERTHING TRACK. i) CLICK ON CONCERNED ROUTE BUTTON AND SELECT CONCERNED OVERLAP RELEASE AND CLICK ON "CONFIRMATION (OK)". ii) THE OVERLAP GETS RELEASED AFTER 120 SECONDS. iii) EACH SUCH OPERATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON COUNTER.
SIGNAL SPECIFIC NOTES - II
BLOCK WORKING: see table "1. BLOCK WORKING".
DETAILS OF TRACK CIRCUITS: see table "2. DETAILS OF TRACK CIRCUITS".
DETAILS OF AXLE COUNTERS: see table "3. DETAILS OF AXLE COUNTERS".
DETAILS OF MOTOR OPERATED POINTS WITH CRANK HANDLE GROUPING: see table "4".
DETAILS OF SIDING POINTS: NIL.
INTERLOCKED LC GATE DETAIL: see table "6".
COMMUNICATIION DETAILS: TELEPHONE COMMUNICATION PROVIDED BETWEEN SM AND L.C.No.s. 20, 24.
DETAILS OF SIGNAL ROUTES HAVING ALTERNATE OVERLAPS: see table "8".
DETAILS OF SIGNAL ROUTE OVERLAP: see table "9".
TRACK SECTION TABLE: NIL

EMERGENCY SUB ROUTE RELEASE- PROCEDURE FOR EMERGENCY SUB ROUTE RELEASE, WHEN SUB ROUTE GETS LOCKED AND ALL TRACK CIRCUITS IN THE SUB ROUTE ARE IN UP CONDITION. i) SUB ROUTE IN REAR IS CLEAR CONDITION. ii) CLICK ON CONCERNED POINT/SUB ROUTE BUTTON AND EMERGENCY SUB ROUTE RELEASE. iii) THE SUB ROUTE GETS RELEASED AFTER 120 SECONDS, IF SUB ROUTE IN CLEAR. iv) EACH SUCH OPERATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON COUNTER.

SUPER EMERGENCY SUB ROUTE RELEASE- PROCEDURE FOR SUPER EMERGENCY SUB ROUTE RELEASE, WHEN SUB ROUTE GETS LOCKED AND ALL TRACK CIRCUITS IN THE SUB ROUTE IS IN DOWN CONDITION. i) SUB ROUTE IN REAR IS IN CLEAR CONDITION. ii) INSERT PHYSICAL SUPER EMERGENCY KEY. iii) CLICK ON CONCERNED POINT/SUB ROUTE BUTTON AND SUPER EMERGENCY SUB ROUTE RELEASE. iv) THE SUB ROUTE GETS RELEASED AFTER 120 SECONDS. v) EACH SUCH OPERATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON COUNTER.
ALL STARTERS/STOP BOARDS ARE PROVIDED AT 0-3m DISTANCE FROM GLUED JOINTS AS PER PARA 17.2.5(iii) OF SEM.
